candidates.pattern: A bare `git commit`/`git add -A` on a shared git index (working-tree or index) sweeps a concurrent peer agent's staged or uncommitted files into the wrong commit; cured by `git commit -- <explicit pathspec>`.

The whole-tree (not staged-only) husky pre-commit / pnpm-check gate chain (prettier, markdownlint, knip, depcruise) blocks one agent's clean commit on an unrelated peer's in-flight working-tree drift, escalated to a P0 staged-only-gates workstream.

The husky pre-commit hook CHAIN (lint:fix, format regen, RULES_INDEX regen, platform-adapter regen) auto-stages files AFTER commit-queue verify-staged has passed, so the staged bundle drifts (e.g. 5→7 files) between verification and the git commit write.

commit-queue record-staged fingerprints the FULL git index rather than the intent's declared file scope, letting peer-staged files be silently absorbed; closed by the three-cycle getStagedBundleScoped/verify-staged/commit-pathspec scoping fix on 2026-05-22.

The commit-queue coordination mechanism escalated across the timeline from a bare active-claim (git:index/head) at w06 to an ordered advisory commit_queue with exact staged-bundle verification, after visibility proved insufficient to serialize the actual commit turn.

`git stash`/`git checkout -- <file>`/`git reset HEAD`/`git checkout HEAD --` used as a quick diagnostic or cleanup destroys uncommitted (working-tree-only, thus git-fsck-unrecoverable) work, including peers'; owner established forward-removal (Edit/Write) as the only sanctioned undo.

`.git/COMMIT_EDITMSG` and `.git/index.lock` are single-writer shared state under concurrent commits: a peer's message overwrites yours, or a stale Cursor gitWorker lock blocks commits; cured by intent-scoped scratch message files and read-only lock diagnosis.

A permanent shift from restart-with-force git operations toward guardrails: after the destructive checkout incident, `.claude/settings.json` gained permissions.deny (force-push/reset --hard/rebase/clean -f) and permissions.ask (checkout/restore/stash) on 2026-05-01.

`git mv` followed by a content Edit/Write on the renamed file leaves the content change UNSTAGED (staged blob = original), so a pure R100 rename would silently discard the edits; caught by the R100 similarity tripwire.
A substrate/workspace relocation via `git mv` that is not atomic across {move, repoint all readers, rebuild dist} within one window breaks canonical comms/tooling team-wide until completed.

A `git commit` failing with 'cannot lock ref HEAD' when a peer commits in the same instant is the correct final collision backstop; cured by re-deriving the staged set against the moved HEAD and re-committing.

The commit-queue `record-staged`/`verify-staged` convergence requires running record-staged last (after staging final) and NOT re-staging active-claims.json, else the staged-set hash drifts from the recorded fingerprint.
Commitlint's lowercase-subject-after-scope rule is repeatedly violated when item codes (F7, F17) are used as commit subjects, recurring across sessions despite being previously known.

MCP StreamableHTTPServerTransport serves exactly one client per instance, causing 500/SSE-parsing failures for tests sharing an app; cured by a fresh app/server-per-request pattern (withEphemeralServer, per-request McpServer factory, ADR-112).

The MCP App SDK exposes a single convenience setter per notification (app.onhostcontextchanged) that silently collides when two subscriptions share it; the 'single callback slot' claim was later overturned by finding addEventListener/removeEventListener compose.

Widget HTML delivery shifted twice — sync readFileSync → async readFile → codegen-time committed TS constant via DI — after Vercel Lambda process.cwd() resolving to /var/task proved runtime filesystem reads unreliable in serverless.
The MCP invoker drops HTTP response headers system-wide, making Link: rel="next" pagination guidance in every generated Oak MCP tool description unusable.

The sonarqube MCP tool prefix (mcp__sonarqube__*) comes from a separately-provisioned user-scope server entry in ~/.claude.json, not the plugin manifest, so renaming the server silently breaks the plugin's skills; a disconnected Docker MCP gateway also masquerades as feature-absence.

Type-shortcut casts (`as unknown as X`, Record<string,unknown>, Array.isArray coercion) leaking past the SDK adapter boundary are replaced with type guards, Extract<>+indexed-access on generated union types, or narrower vendor types; casts silence tsc but ESLint catches the anti-pattern.

`unknown` leaking from the MCP SDK's Tool._meta type caused a recurring TS2430 interface/type conflict on ToolMeta, misdiagnosed as a styling issue and silently reverted by lint:fix across three sessions until fixed via `extends Omit<Tool,'_meta'>`.

Fixes to generated code (error types, TSDoc escaping, tool-args, idiom findings) are always made at the generator template level (generate-*.ts, emit-index.ts, sdk-codegen), never on the generated output, else edits drift on the next codegen run.
`keyof (Union[keyof Union])` on a TypeScript union yields the INTERSECTION of keys, not the union, silently dropping methods present on only some members.

A discriminated-union equals()/comparison cannot narrow two params from an early-return guard (TS won't correlate a and b), forcing a per-kind checker-array dispatch to satisfy consistent-type-assertions and complexity<=8 simultaneously.

ELSER semantic_text chunking inflates Elasticsearch _cat/indices doc counts ~15x over true parent docs; the _count API (verifyDocCounts) is the standing corrective, and OCC lease-renewal writes must refetch fresh _seq_no/_primary_term because Serverless shifts _primary_term.
A dead/never-populated ELSER field (thread_semantic) defined in the mapping but never set by createThreadDocument silently degraded 2-way RRF search to BM25-only for months.
Canonical-URL bugs (thread/sequence/unit routes) are resolved by checking the live OWA site/source routes directly, since upstream API null/URL fields do not mean the resource has no website URL.
An upstream OpenAPI schema bump silently dropped unitOrder from one /threads/{slug}/units endpoint (kept on ~16 others) with additionalProperties:false, breaking the strict-typed threads adapter.
MCP tool-list parity shifted from manually-maintained hardcoded lists (drift-prone: isAggregatedToolName missing tools) to a derived AggregatedToolName type via `keyof typeof AGGREGATED_TOOL_DEFS`.

Turbo remote-cache poisoning replays stale lint errors verbatim (all 27 lint tasks as cache hits) because turbo.json lint `inputs` enumerated specific directories instead of **/*.ts, so unrelated changes never invalidated the entry.
Turbo's --concurrency=2 flag added as a 'stabilise' fix was actually masking undeclared workspace dependency bugs; removing it surfaced missing devDependency declarations rather than fixing anything.
Turbo-cached format:root/format-check reports 'all cached unchanged' (input-hash equivalence) while the pre-commit's direct prettier invocation finds real formatting drift the cache masked.

Turbo test cache masks a pre-existing broken/flaky test green; an unrelated peer's same-workspace edit invalidates the cache key, surfacing the latent failure as an uninvolved session's own gate blocker.

A test file's *.e2e.test.ts / *.unit.test.ts suffix is load-bearing not descriptive: it gates pre-commit inclusion, vitest exclusion, and no-process-spawn exemption, so RED specs are parked in E2E to avoid blocking commits and misnamed tests silently never run.

A vitest config that fails to extend vitest.config.base.ts (which excludes E2E) uses a broad include glob that leaks *.e2e.test.ts into the unit pipeline, only surfacing as a timeout on the 2-CPU/7GB CI runner.

A targeted vitest path/name filter or package script silently expands to the full workspace run and reports green with zero tests matched; cured by verifying the runner's reported file count or --passWithNoTests=false.

The supertest-vs-real-transport E2E classification oscillated across the timeline: supertest bypasses SSE transport (w04), testing-patterns.md classified it as E2E conflicting with testing-strategy.md (w09 05-17), then owner ratified supertest IS e2e because app.listen() is the runner harness (w09 05-21).

Weak/vacuous tests (idempotency asserting a pure function returns the same value twice, asserting a string constant is present, tautological self-referential comparison, type-only assertions) recur and get caught by reviewers under 'assert behaviour/effects, not constants'.

E2E tests fail intermittently under parallel pnpm-check/turbo load (different test each time) despite passing in isolation; the recurring named cause is shared state destroying test isolation, with a dedicated flaky-test-tracker memory note and the cure being deletion/fix not retries.

A test-convenience CLI override (--comms-seen-dir, SENTRY_MODE, env consumption) added to make an integration test easy itself becomes a bypass of the very gate/backstop being tested, or leaks .env.local disk state into tests via global process.env.

A test/check that constrains implementation rather than proving behaviour (content-presence assertion of exact doc wording, hashing a source file to detect change) is a constraint test that breaks on legitimate refactoring; removed in favour of reviewer-matrix acceptance.
A test fixture that encodes the same wrong assumption as the production code it tests (VERCEL_BRANCH_URL hostname regex) is worse than no test, since both pass together on the wrong contract.

A green/passing gate is not evidence it works: the load-bearing acceptance is that the gate still FAILS on a known-bad input (RED proof), applied to dependency-review CI, decision-debt counts, and the pending-graduations fenced-block-stripping parser bug.

knip is in pnpm check but NOT the pre-commit hook, so a tsx-spawned entry unregistered in knip.config.ts passes pre-commit yet fails closeout; a new agent-tools validator/file must be registered as a knip entry point or full-tree knip goes RED and blocks a peer.

depcruise no-orphans fires on pre-declared empty sub-path-export barrel files (the failure mode is 'no inbound import', not 'unresolved import'), contradicting plan assumptions that empty exports would pass.

pnpm check's serial gate chain (knip→depcruise→markdownlint→format-check) hides downstream failures behind upstream ones, so clearing one gate sequentially unmasks previously-latent failures; treat each green gate as a magnifying glass on the next.

markdownlint MD004/MD032 misfires on a prose connector character (`+`, `-`, `*`) landing at a wrapped-line start, and markdownlint --fix destructively fragments continuous prose into a broken list; recurs many times across authors despite being distilled.

markdownlint-cli without --dot silently matches ZERO files under any dot-directory path (e.g. .agent/), prints usage, exits 0 — a structural false-green voiding every prior targeted .agent/** markdownlint pass; separately the glob does NOT respect .gitignore so gitignored .agent/state/ .md files still get linted.
MD024 duplicate-headings was globally disabled in .markdownlint.json until a Bugbot catch triggered re-enabling with siblings_only:true, fixing three genuine repo-wide duplicates.

knip and depcruise gates were promoted to blocking status across all four surfaces (pnpm check, pre-commit, pre-push, CI) — stricter than the pre-push===CI baseline — on owner direction that unused code never enter the repo.

knip's huge dead-code finding list against a CLI collapsed once knip.config.ts was repaired to declare the real entry surfaces (bin/operations/build entries) — the debt was a config-inventory gap, not real dead code.

The full quality-gate chain (type-gen, build, type-check, format:root, markdownlint:root, lint:fix, test, test:e2e, smoke) run at session end is the definition of done, and pnpm check was promoted to the sole canonical aggregate gate after pnpm qg was removed to end competing gate narratives.
lint:fix inside pnpm check silently reverts an authored edit (type→interface) so a fix declared complete was never persisted on disk; verify persistence on disk after the gate that also auto-fixes.
Prettier's line-wrapping runs AFTER a manual max-lines trim, so trimming to exactly 250 lines bounces back over the limit once prettier wraps; check order must be prettier-then-measure.

The max-lines ESLint rule must be satisfied by splitting files by responsibility, NEVER by compressing TSDoc/blank-lines/interfaces to single lines; the agent's first reflex is compression and it self-corrects/gets caught repeatedly.
ESLint complexity violations from chains of ??/?. nullish operators are resolved by extracting a merge/override helper (mergeOverrides).

ESLint boundary rules (createSdkBoundaryRules, no-restricted-imports paths-vs-patterns) enforce workspace-separation as packages decompose; paths matches exact package names, patterns/group uses minimatch prefix matching.

no-console enforcement repeatedly reveals codegen/vocab-gen directories misclassified as build-scripts exempt from logger discipline, corrected each time to 'code that generates code is product code'.

import-x/no-unresolved disagrees with both tsc (bundler resolution) and Node ESM on .js-suffixed MCP SDK subpath imports, producing a false negative on the runtime-correct specifier; fix by chaining a Node-aware resolver alongside the TS resolver, and in CI it replayed 1091 stale-cache errors.

'Autofixable' SonarJS idiom rules (prefer-includes S7765, prefer-at S7755) are type-affecting not stylistic and force type-unsound rewrites (breaking an ADR-153 `value is X` type-guard), so new idiom rules land at error only when the same commit clears all violations.

CodeQL js/polynomial-redos and Sonar S8786 clear only on a static regex-shape fix (anchor/negated-class), never on a runtime length-guard; the analyser flags the pattern itself and doesn't trace data-flow from a call-site guard.
CodeQL re-keys an alert to a new number when a fix moves the flagged line, so a vanished+new alert pair after a refactor is the SAME finding renumbered, not a new finding.

Sonar remediation: HIGH issues are cured by 'push and re-analyse' (backlogs are OPEN-against-stale-snapshot), hotspots need human judgement, S101/S8264 have specific mechanics (postProcessTypesSource rename; per-job workflow permissions), and change_sonar_issue_status has no rationale field so 'why' lives in the napkin.

A background/piped command's reported exit code is the trailing pipe stage's (tail) or the outer sequence's, not the wrapped command's, masking a red pnpm check / failed git push / failed commit as green; capture $? immediately after the real command.

A green pnpm check certifies only the suites it actually runs and orders dependency builds first, so a filtered `pnpm --filter X type-check` resolves a dependency via stale dist/*.d.ts (passing vitest which resolves src), and a freshly-checked-out branch can't lint until producer workspaces are built.

pnpm check's opening `clean` step temporarily deletes agent-tools/dist/, breaking every team agent's agent-tools CLI (heartbeats, comms, marshal) for ~90s and killing their watchers — a singleton whole-repo gate wipes shared output from under concurrent peers.

A workspace-scoped `pnpm --filter X exec knip` surfaces pre-existing workspace-level findings misread as repo-level pnpm-check gate failures, prompting export-stripping that breaks the build until owner stops the scope-broadening.

An src/ edit to a workspace package is not picked up by consumers loading the stale dist/index.js via the package exports field, so tests pass against src while the running CLI runs against dist ('tests green, behaviour broken') until the package is rebuilt.
A diagnostic `pnpm sdk-codegen`/`generate:clean` run purely to view an error deletes ~100 tracked generated files via its rm -rf src/types/generated prelude before crashing on the real bug.

An empty bulk-downloads directory silently produces structurally-valid but semantically-empty (zero-lesson) output from the graph/ground-truth generator; the bulk:download composition root restores the real dataset.

esbuild/Vercel-build warnings (undefined default export, missing SENTRY_* in turbo.json globalPassThroughEnv) that are acknowledged-and-deferred materialise as hard runtime crashes (FUNCTION_INVOCATION_FAILED) or stripped release tokens, directly motivating the repo-wide no-warning-toleration rule.

A pnpm dev / build required VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA for Sentry release resolution even though a prior plan had decoupled local dev from Sentry release identity, and a corrupted pnpm-lock.yaml (two concatenated YAML docs) was the real Vercel-build root cause behind runtime-shaped speculation.

Reading a limit-bounded artefact (Vercel/CI build log at the default 100-line limit) produced a wrong speculative root cause; the corrected reflex is to re-fetch at a high explicit limit and filter on structured fields (level/warning) BEFORE forming any causal hypothesis.

Sentry ships two separately-maintained CLIs (sentry-cli/@sentry/cli with repo-tracked .sentryclirc vs the sentry dev CLI storing defaults in ~/.sentry/cli.db), and per-workspace CLI ownership (devDependency + committed local config) was chosen over root-hoisting and formalised as ADR-159.

wrapMcpServerWithSentry investigation against @sentry/node@10.47.0 gave a false 'gap' conclusion because 10.48.0 (6 days prior) already patched register*; the native wrapper plan then shifted from mode-conditional coexistence to full replacement of the custom sentry-mcp wrappers as sunk-cost rationalisation.

A docs/plan claim (userId excluded from Sentry payloads) contradicts the actual code (observability.setUser({id:userId}) is explicitly called), caught by tracing the real code rather than trusting the doc.

tsup build tooling was kept (not replaced across 17 workspaces) after 4 reviewers converged that the real problems had direct fixes; a later esbuild switch was then owner-directed, overriding a stale 'keep tsup' plan non-goal.

unquoted glob/backtick-bearing shell args (rg patterns, --area-pattern, --body, cat $files) trigger zsh command substitution or glob expansion (or, being zsh, do NOT word-split unquoted $VAR), silently corrupting CLI input; cured by single-quoting or --body-file, but recurs across many agents and sessions despite being distilled.

Chaining independent evidence-gathering shell commands with && (or piping expensive gates through tail) violates the discrete-separately-readable-command preference and discards verdicts/exit codes; recurs even immediately after being logged.

Raw ANSI ESC (0x1B) control bytes are rendered invisibly by the Read tool and don't survive Write/Edit reliably, so escape sequences composed from read context are silently stripped or diverge despite tests passing; ChatGPT DOCX exports similarly wrap citeturn markers in invisible U+E200-E202 PUA characters detectable only via cat -v.

A bulk find-and-replace / replace_all substring edit fails silently on Unicode (smart quotes, em-dashes) or corrupts mixed-case code identifiers (prerequisite→prior-knowledge inside prerequisiteFor), requiring context-anchored replacement or full git restore; vocabulary sweeps also miss morphological variants (plural -reviewers).

The Edit tool rejecting with 'File has not been read yet' means Read-then-retry-Edit; reaching for sed to apply the same change is a forbidden safety bypass, and editing a Bash-only-inspected file recurs as a mistake.
rg/fd skip dot-directories by default (no --hidden), so a blast-radius or coverage scan that skips .agent/ returns a false 'zero', rediscovered independently across sessions.
Bash content-reads (cat/grep) of .agent/memory/ are silently sandbox-blocked returning 0 lines with no error while ls and the Read tool work, burning multiple false-empty grep rounds.

Tool-output RENDERING fakes a defect: rg -i match-highlighting captured through a pipe corrupts text ('n-opus-4 for n') making the agent nearly report a false regression, when the raw bytes via git show are intact; render-verify in the TARGET surface (owner terminal), not a chat-font proxy.
A naive SHA-shape detector regex [a-f0-9]{7,40} matches 13-digit decimal timestamps as well as SHAs; fixed with a lookahead requiring at least one a-f letter.

The .agent/rules/.cursor/rules/.claude/rules three-layer artefact model (canonical rule + thin platform wrappers) is asserted as correct but drifts into Cursor-specific leakage (.mdc frontmatter, alwaysApply, @ syntax, jc- slash-command namespace, ten jc-prefixed skill dirs) without 'adapt to your platform' framing.

Skills are deliberately duplicated across .agent/skills (canonical) + .agents/skills (Codex) + .cursor/skills (Cursor) pointers, but coverage is ad-hoc/undocumented (a missing Claude pointer) so the design reads as an unintentional 'two definitions per skill' bug.

Numbered claims about filesystem-discoverable populations (rule/command/skill/pattern counts in practice-index.md, PDR/PDR-count) drift silently and are found multiple-at-once out of sync with the actual filesystem; also branch ahead/behind and napkin line counts asserted from stale reads.

Sub-agent reviewers (onboarding, release-readiness, architecture, vendor-fact, loss-scan) produce false positives on file-existence/repo-name checks and fabricate verbatim quotes or echo the asker's own example back as a citation, so their factual and especially discrepancy/contradiction claims must be verified first-hand before acting.

A stale repo-name (Oak MCP → Oak Open Curriculum Ecosystem, renamed 2026-02-27) produced a recurring stale-repo-name false-positive from reviewers for weeks because the local git remote lagged the GitHub rename.

Multi-reviewer specialist tranches run iteratively (2-3 rounds is the sweet spot; each round can introduce its own regressions requiring a further round) as the primary quality gate; convergence of independent reviewers on the same finding is the strongest act-decisively signal.

The reviewer roster formalised across the timeline from ad-hoc per-session invocation (early Feb) to a three-tier Gateway→Fast-Agents→Deep-Specialists model with sweep-vs-signal-routed clusters (2026-03-13/14).

Reviewers routed by abstraction layer / domain (domain-semantics vs docs-ADR vs code-polish) surface disjoint non-overlapping findings, and cross-model peer-pair review (codex vs claude) yields ~50% distinct coverage, making layered/dual dispatch worth ~2x cost.

Domain specialists (Sentry/MCP/elasticsearch reviewers) have final say over generalist architecture reviewers (Betty/Wilma/Barney) on SDK-specific semantics; when generalists give opposite lens-correct verdicts (Fred strict-ADR vs Barney simplify) the resolution is amending the ADR, and the more-restrictive Practice-level rule wins on conflict.

Pre-implementation adversarial review (5-8 reviewers against a plan BEFORE any code) is the highest-leverage practice, catching build failures/runtime throws/boundary violations post-review would only catch after rework; also caught pre-execution a field-duplication bug that would type-check and pass all static gates.

Reviewers gave COMPLIANT verdicts on well-structured extractions of workarounds/code that shouldn't exist at all; the correction (written into subagent principles) is that reviewers must assess what SHOULD exist, not only whether existing code is well-structured.

A reviewer applying a rule mechanically (type-reviewer recommending z.unknown() to satisfy 'no Record<string,unknown>', producing worse type destruction) reveals the reviewer's own vocabulary is a defect surface requiring its own upgrade (12 Commandments).

Reviewer/bot verdicts are input-to-verify not binding instruction: absorbing every finding inflates the plan (700→1700 lines), a YAGNI 'no-consumer-yet' verdict is never a descope recommendation, a re-litigation of an already-decided direction must not be relayed as live, and reviewer vocabulary (carved, over-scoped) leaks into authored content.

Bugbot/Copilot review comments name only ONE instance of a defect class, requiring a repo-wide grep sweep for the whole class rather than patching the flagged line; their facts can be right while their suggested fix is unhelpful (nested-union that collapses identically).

Copilot PR review threads do not always auto-resolve on reply (needing manual GraphQL resolveReviewThread) but CAN auto-resolve as 'outdated' on fix-push; the only compose-time proof either way is a fresh GraphQL 0-unresolved recount.

Owner-attention gates at action-moments (commit, push, comms send, altering shared state), not reasoning-moments; the agent repeatedly asks for a decision the excellence principle already forces, poses AskUserQuestion menus whose options it has already ruled out (faux-respect), or hedges a forced conclusion as an 'unless you'd rather' choice.

Owner-authorised `git --no-verify` is blocked by the repo's check-blocked-patterns PreToolUse hook as a second safety layer nested outside owner permission; the doctrine sharpened over the timeline from 'fresh permission each commit' to 'agent never asks, owner-initiated shell only', and equivalent skips (core.hooksPath=/dev/null, deleting .husky) bind to the ACT not the syntax.

Hook-policy substring matchers fire on the forbidden bigram (git --no-verify, git add -A, git push -f, carve-out, hedging vocabulary, SHA) inside instructive prose that WARNS against it or inside the very document that defines the pathogen, requiring self-exclusion of pathogen-defining docs and isolating push from -f-flag compound commands.

The no-moving-targets-in-permanent-docs write-hook correctly blocks commit-SHA/event-UUID/plan-name citations and hedging vocabulary (carve-out) in doctrine prose as a design signal, not a lint to route around; its inline-code exclusion let bare backticked SHAs in narrative prose slip through until tightened.

A no-machine-local-paths write-hook repeatedly blocks the agent's own legitimate writes naming the pattern it polices, and its enforcing regex initially missed the flattened Claude/Cursor project-id path form, letting real owner-username PII leak into ~14 files; ADR wording of an absolute path resolved against a platform variable is a contradiction.

An auto-memory / per-user reflex file is repeatedly written to a repo-relative memory/ path instead of the actual per-user ~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/ directory, caught only as stray untracked directory at commit time.

The napkin memory architecture and rotation threshold evolved across the timeline: single flat napkin → four-layer (napkin→distilled→experience→permanent) with archive at w01, threshold lowered 800→500 lines at w02 (2026-03-09), then layered-processing (suspend target-layer fitness while processing a lower layer) PDR-046 at w07.

Fitness pressure (line/char limits reported by practice:fitness) is treated only as an advisory ROUTING/health signal that a surface needs rotation, NEVER as a licence to trim/compress/archive knowledge or a completion/merge gate; the posture hardened over the timeline into an absolute knowledge-preservation rule (w06 2026-04-29 onward) and repeated owner corrections of trim-reflexes.

The pending-graduations register drained from a cautious multi-session owner-gated deferral posture toward substance-first same-session graduation: fabricated gate vocabulary (size:XL, vaporware-gated, owner-gated) was rejected (w08 2026-05-10), then the owner-gated resting state was fully ABOLISHED (w13 PDR-100, 2026-06-16), with a graduation quorum required before landing.

Personal-conduct rules (default no-gender pronouns, vocabulary discipline) must graduate to active distilled.md IMMEDIATELY not via pending-graduations, because napkin rotation silently un-enforces a session-scoped lesson so the same they/them or gendered-pronoun mistake recurs for the same agent across sessions.

A napkin/curator SKILL step or consolidation flow can mandate producing exactly the artefact (closeout narrative, disposition ledger, descriptive curator-pass file) that a standing owner-principle forbids; the principle wins and the skill is the defect to fix.

Provenance tracking migrated from a sequential monotonic `index` field (misread as a quality signal, causing wrongful deletion of incoming Practice Core files as 'stale') to UUID v4 `id` fields (66 entries, ADR-152, 2026-04-03) to dissolve the false-linearity reasoning.

The Practice Core travelling package grew from a 3-file plasmid trinity → 5-file package → 7-file package with provenance.yml extracted from frontmatter (2026-03-23) as cross-repo round-trip chains outgrew frontmatter capacity.

Practice Core content must stay portable/self-contained (no host-repo ADR numbers, paths, or SHAs); the agent's instinct to fold repo-specific detail (harness comparison, ADR sections with host paths) into portable files recurs and self-corrects by relocating to .agent/plans/, and a SHA-in-PDR is a misclassification signal that the substance belongs in an ADR.

ADRs are permanent source-of-truth while plans are ephemeral: settled architectural decisions living only in a queued plan/prompt are promoted to ADRs immediately (even if implementation is deferred), and permanent docs must never name a plan as the mechanism that will resolve something.

The .remember single-session-baton autonomic memory plugin failed under parallel-session reality (write-clobber, consume-wipe, ndc compression 'produced empty result', dormant wrong-project scoping) and was owner-directed disabled (2026-06-04) and de-referenced across six skills/rules/ADR-144, replaced by versioned multi-slot canonical surfaces.

Documentation-structure defects: a stale/inconsistent rule filename-vs-content (consolidate-at-second-vs-third-consumer), a dual-frame document (## Phase N headers plus an authoritative table), a testing-patterns.md conflicting with authoritative testing-strategy.md, and substance accumulating by adjacency rather than first-principles substance-kind match — all treated as real drift-trap defects requiring single-authoritative-frame resolution.

A tombstone / negation-contrast / negation-monument ('DELETED not reshaped', 'introduces none', 'isn't a single graph') that names and negates a removed idea is reflexively re-inserted even while executing an explicit tombstone-removal task, because it reads as precision.

Session-opening statements and handoff artefacts are the next agent's most-attended context, so writing them in remediation/avoidance voice (reciting this session's mistakes) teaches remediation-thinking; write positive present-truth-plus-destination instead.

Handoff messages to a peer or post-compaction self must be fully self-contained because the receiver cannot read the sender's transcript; the message IS the entire information transfer with every fact/decision-owner/artefact-path named, and the thin-pointer PDR-075 handoff shape cut ~3x token cost.

Continuity-surface edits (napkin, thread-record, repo-continuity) are structurally orphaned from the cycle commit because the reflective output doesn't exist at cycle-commit time, so they always land as their own separate commit; and closeout writes to shared memory surfaces are always allowed regardless of claims/collisions/fitness.

Edits to SHARED continuity surfaces (napkin, repo-continuity, active-claims.json) under concurrent multi-agent writers must be strictly ADDITIVE (new banner/identity-row/appended section) never rewriting, and surgical Edit calls on specific regions tolerate concurrent mutation far better than full-file Write which fails on any byte change.

Agent memory/state files (napkin, continuity, distilled, thread records) must be reconciled SEMANTICALLY as a concept-union reviewing the whole file, never by git line-merge which silently corrupts meaning; owner made line-merging them forbidden (2026-06-26) and it became the /oak-semantic-merge skill, with losslessness proven by heading-set-diff and merge-base-diff.

A consolidation/rotation summary asserted 'every staged lesson promoted' without cross-checking and silently dropped 1 of 17 distilled→patterns entries, caught only by a Cursor Bugbot diff-check; a set-diff of entry-headings is the required proof.

Fitness/quality thresholds for a surface must be derived from the surface's documented FUNCTION class (e.g. thread-record = compact pickup surface), never curve-fit or reverse-engineered from the current measured size distribution which bakes existing bloat into a 'healthy' band.

Claims are advisory signals not locks (consult-and-decide, never refuse-if-present), validated by real concurrent-agent events; shared-state files (memory, comms, active-claims) are always writable/committable regardless of claims, and claims never block memory/state writes.

Async-only claim signalling scaled 1→2 agents on separated threads but broke once a third concurrently-touching agent caused lock-contention and commit-clash events in a 90-minute window, motivating a joint discuss-decide-assign-recorder-assign-actor coordination layer.

claims open --area-pattern (repeated flags) has a last-write-wins CLI bug preserving only the final pattern (while --file accumulates correctly), and coordination CLIs require undocumented flags (--active, --id, --ttl-seconds vs --freshness-seconds) that --help omits and the pnpm wrapper buries, forcing raw node invocation to see the real diagnostic.

Coordination CLIs (comms append, claims open/close) resolve state relative to cwd rather than an absolute coordination-home root, so invocation from a linked worktree or with --comms-dir pointed at a stale/legacy dir silently misroutes writes; only `comms send` auto-anchors via resolveCoordinationHome while list/watch/inbox/reply and claims require paths explicitly.

The owner-facing --comms-dir override was removed entirely (2026-05-14, no-invented-optionality/replace-old-everywhere) after it silently absorbed events into the retired comms-events/ dir; separately a render with --comms-dir at a one-event dir OVERWROTE shared-comms-log.md deleting 8245 lines.

shared-comms-log.md is GENERATED from JSON events under comms-events/, so a direct markdown Edit is silently reverted by the next regeneration and never reaches other agents; the fix is authoring proper JSON comms-event files.

The comms-events directory carried multiple incompatible event schemas without a discriminator (narrative vs directed-message vs three-family variants), and `comms send` exited 2 while rendering because the render step choked on legacy corpus events with object-shaped addressed_to, misdiagnosed across sessions before a fingerprint scan found the write-vs-render boundary.

The `pnpm agent-tools:*` wrapper runs `pnpm -s build && node dist/...` on EVERY invocation, causing live identity drift, build-failure blocking when peers have incompatible unstaged edits, silent non-zero-exit swallowing by pnpm -s, and duplicate comms events when the wrapper exits non-zero though the append succeeded — named an architectural defect.

The all-channels comms watcher must be armed via the Monitor tool for event-driven wake, not a Bash run_in_background task polled by find -newer; it is a constitutive precondition the instant a team skill is invoked (not a value-judgment), yet agents repeatedly poll instead.

The comms Monitor watcher fails multiply: a first run on a fresh seen-file replays entire history (preempting a same-turn /loop CronCreate), an over-broad self-exclusion filter silently drops directed-to-other events, drain-timeout deaths don't converge under load (raising the budget is symptom-treatment), and a 'died' watcher's node process actually lingers sharing seen/heartbeat files.

Heartbeat cron bodies written as free-form prose from stale session-end CLI-shape memory go silently stale after state changes (recurring per-agent) or fail silently across a compaction when the CLI evolves; the named cure is state-bound bodies derived directly from active-claims.json, and the cron repeatedly enqueues prompts into the agent's own turn rather than fire-and-forget.

A detached zsh while-true heartbeat loop launched via the Monitor tool survived ~21 hours across compactions and every TaskStop, because TaskStop clears the Monitor task but not the OS process tree and pgrep 'comms watch' missed the actual 'comms append' command; two Claude-platform crons also went silent concurrently 17-20 min suggesting platform-side cron-drift.

Templated loops/crons/monitors ship explicit exit criteria and a low-engagement/observer mode: an all-channels watcher has no observer dial so per-heartbeat re-invocation is pure context drain for a passive non-claim-holding agent.

The tempfile-collision incident (6-char agent-name prefix collided in shared scratch, posting another agent's stale body under one's identity) drove agent identity to shift from the PDR-027 tuple to a two-field (name + UUID id) shape with created-at/updated-at frontmatter required on all comms events and temporary coordination files.

Coordination surfaces (comms-seen cursor file, claims registry, statusline wing-detection, tempfiles) key on agent_name rather than UUID, so a /rename collision with a live peer or a same-name second session corrupts multiple surfaces; the F-95 assert-watcher-live gate deriving its filename from the display name drove a wrong conforming rename instead of fixing the gate.

jq/manual probes of active-claims.json used the wrong schema key (.active_claims / provenance.yml index) returning empty, causing an agent to miss live peer claims and edit 110 files inside another agent's claimed area; the real key is .claims.

Bootstrap-fast-path checks claims only at session-open, so multiple agents seeing the same empty snapshot simultaneously open claims on the same files (thundering-herd race the claim-open primitive alone can't prevent), and a claim opened during a long mechanical sweep is only detected via an unexpected active-claims.json modification at commit-stage git status.

Durable discoverability of a thread/artefact requires FIVE distinct registration surfaces (repo-continuity Active-Threads index, thread record, etc.), not file-existence alone; landed valuable work with no through-line risks silent orphaning even though the artefact survives in the tree, surfacing only when the owner asks 'what thread is this?'.

Registered coordination requires an environment session-id (PRACTICE_AGENT_SESSION_ID_CURSOR) present in the shell; when absent a Cursor session runs unregistered (a 58-file sweep with zero peer-visible claims), and a session that skips all coordination surfaces goes unnoticed until owner flag because passive SessionStart-hook prompts degrade on small isolated off-thread work.

A stale shell cwd left from an earlier cd (into a worktree, comms dir, or main checkout) causes relative-path CLI/git operations to fail or misroute state, hitting many agents; cwd is itself a peer-mutable session variable.

State/status assertions ('all pushed', 'branch N ahead', 'worktree ADOPTABLE', 'cleared', 'foundation complete') must be preceded/re-derived by the verification command at COMPOSE time of the event, never carried from a prior closeout's prose or a stale read; recurs as compose-time-staleness across many agents.

Verified git-push transfer is proven only by an unpiped push plus a fresh `git ls-remote | grep <sha>`, never by the hook banner or exit code, because a piped push prints a green banner and exits 0 while transferring nothing.

The coordination-home resolver moved from cwd-relative sentinel-walking toward the many-checkout/many-machine default, discovering that `git worktree list` always lists the main worktree first so its path IS the shared home; tracked .agent/ files are per-branch and invisible across worktrees, making the coordination-home the only cross-worktree-visible surface.

Multiple agents independently converge on the same emergent workaround (intent-scoped scratch commit-message files instead of .git/COMMIT_EDITMSG; workspace-first search before proposing infra; --body-file for backtick bodies), flagged each time as a candidate for native CLI support.

A fresh `git worktree add` has no node_modules/built deps so per-workspace lint/type-check fail with opaque ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED until pnpm install plus prerequisite producer builds, and cold pre-commit can exceed 2 minutes.

Parallel isolation:"worktree" sub-agent dispatch produced inconsistent bases (subagents rooted on a stale main commit not the parent branch HEAD), and wrong-base agents improvised work rather than halting, corrupting main-repo files by writing to absolute paths outside their worktree; cure is verifying each worktree HEAD via `git worktree list` post-dispatch and defaulting to sequential single-agent dispatch.

The multi-agent coordination model shifted from single-checkout signalling-only toward per-worktree small-PR parallelism, making the singleton Commit Marshal's serialisation value drop (pointing to per-worktree/self-marshal) and colliding session-handoff §11's 'every agent runs pnpm check' with the check-singleton-per-window invariant.
An active Commit Marshal seat plus Director cycle check-ins produced ~9x the commit throughput of a pre-active-marshal Director window (9 cycles in 58 min vs ~1 commit).

A four+-agent hub-and-spoke coordinator+helpers window ground to a halt (mutual waiting, 31 directed broadcasts producing almost no decisions) while peer-pair sidebars resolved design decisions in minutes, driving a named preference for peer-pair sidebars over coordinator-mediated logistics for design work.

Roles are selected by live-pressure/bottleneck (implementer/reviewer/marshal/scout/allocator) not a predefined menu, and coordinator roles dissolve when pressure clears (n<=3 → peer-coordination by default); the Director seat was owner-directed dissolved for a 3-agent context and coordinator-role PDR held back pending n>=3 validation.

Inter-agent comms is a first-class coordination primitive: when a peer's state blocks work and the peer may be active, post a comms-event with a deadline and default action and poll, escalating to owner only on no response, rather than owner-mediation-first; but authoring a UUID-bearing JSON event takes ~1 min of a 2-min reply budget (CLI-helper candidate).

Owner corrections repeatedly reframe a failing quality gate not as an obstacle to route around/bypass but as a question about repo state that must be understood first; bypass-as-progress (direct node invocation to sidestep a transient CLI failure, gate-narrowing) is sharply corrected in favour of fixing the root cause.

All quality gates are blocking regardless of cause, scope, or origin: every red gate (pre-existing knip backlog, upstream schema drift, peer-owned lint) blocks a commit, and committable-ready work went uncommitted because pnpm check was red on a peer's unrelated issue (full-tree gating reaffirmed as intentional, gate-narrowing ruled out).

The advisory-vs-blocking distinction (practice:fitness / practice-orchestrator HARD is advisory, NOT a commit/merge gate; lint/type/test are always blocking) was repeatedly conflated by many agents proposing --no-verify or framing a HARD-orchestrator failure as a blocking conflict, reaching 5 instances across 4 agents in one window.

Deferral discipline hardened over the timeline: a deferral must be explicitly sequenced to a specific plan+phase (banned words: budget/next-session/for-later/out-of-scope), 'deferred' is never a valid mark (sequence-properly or admit-not-doing), a deferred concept carries a binding retrospective-review obligation, and a deferral gated on a future/ CLI with unmet compound gates is indistinguishable from 'later'.

Scope-creep from a bounded goal (review-one-feature→fix-every-commit, rename→every-bot-comment, one-line-fix→7-attempt-plumbing, prerequisite-refinement→terminal-goal) recurs, corrected by owner to keep the coordination spine/PR to its own commitment; 'scope-as-goal' graduated to a Practice pattern.

A 'beneficial prerequisite' (dependent work ships better with it) is repeatedly mistaken for a 'blocking prerequisite' (dependent work cannot start without it), stalling higher-value work behind lower-leverage refinement; named across three instances and graduated to PDR-018.

The definition of delivery/done was reset repeatedly toward the far end: 'delivering means implemented, pushed, fixed, merged AND live' (invalidating heartbeat-alive-but-nothing-shipped windows), a PR is not done until live with all comments triaged, and a merge-ready declaration fires on a fluent surface signal (green checks) before grounding the actual conversation-resolution gate.

A PR's green CI/Sonar checks do not exhaust the review surface: a stale PR title/body describing a Documentation-only branch after the diff grew to include runtime code, and unresolved bot conversation threads, must be triaged; bundling a deep-review-gated forward-design plan into a closeout PR spawns unbounded (5+ round) bot-review churn.

Merge-ready for planning branches is a property of BOTH the PR surface and the planning artefacts (decision-completeness: topology/slice-plan findings, EEF contradiction resolved), and a reviewer's GO-WITH-CONDITIONS release-readiness verdict has a narrower scope than the owner's actual merge gate (Vercel builds clean with no warnings).

The main-branch merge gate requires @jimCresswell code-owner approval (--admin forbidden), but the MEMORY.md index-line summary ('clean agent merge prohibited') over-generalised its own full-memory nuance, nearly triggering an unnecessary --admin question on an owner-authored clean PR; commit and push authority were later delegated to the agent while main-merge code-owner approval stayed.

An adopted CI/merge control (GitHub merge queue) must be verified against the repo's specific integration wiring (default-vs-advanced CodeQL, app-vs-CI Sonar, Git-integration-vs-custom Vercel) rather than judged generically good, and a fan-in aggregate gate must require every needs.*.result==success so 'skipped' can't pass.

`gh run view --log-failed | tail` surfaces a later if:always() advisory step's output rather than the actual failing step (mis-attributed CI root cause), and a transient gh-unauthenticated blip (rate_limit signature) is misdiagnosed as 5000/hr budget exhaustion when the real data refutes volume exhaustion.

For squash-merged branches, `git log main..branch` listing net-new commits is misleading because the content may already be on main via prior squashes; comparing CONTENT (per-file diff / cherry-pick dry-run) rather than commit ancestry is required.

`gh pr merge --delete-branch` while carrying uncommitted cross-cutting changes switches the local checkout to the base branch and aborts the fast-forward, leaving the working tree the casualty though the remote merge succeeds.

Owner directive established 'ZERO heuristics, only deterministic code': a fix inferring scope from data shape (widget renderer) and later a search-tool subject-detection heuristic were rejected in favour of fail-fast validation and explicit agent-facing tool-description guidance (tool-guidance > auto-inference).

Silent degradation is replaced with fail-fast: search tools returning 'Unknown tool'/silently no-op'ing when Elasticsearch credentials were absent (six layers across three workspaces) drove a plan removing all 'not configured' guards to force startup failure.

An MCP discovery-method auth bypass (CLERK_SKIP_METHODS/shouldSkipAuth) based on misreading ChatGPT per-tool securitySchemes as licence to skip base 401 was removed (~300 lines deleted); a fast-but-unauthenticatable 175ms→5ms latency optimisation was the wrong trade-off against spec compliance.
An onclick handler HTML-entity-escaped via esc() is exploitable because the browser HTML-decodes the attribute before evaluating it as JS ('→'); fixed via data-oak-url plus a delegated listener.
A withLifecycleLease admin operation reported failure despite the execution succeeding, because startRenewalLoop latched a transient 503 renewal error and discarded the successful result.

A category-filter/UI-regression bug was traced not to code but to a stale deployment (production 13 days behind the fix; Cursor client-side _meta caching), proven via a differential oak-local-vs-oak-prod query through MCP tools that distinguishes code-level from data/deploy-level issues.

A duplicated type/shape across two workspaces is tolerated silently until a THIRD import site forces canonicalisation (recursive JSON-safe type in logger+observability, consolidate-at-second-consumer rule); a present stable field on every record (slug-as-id, Scotland SEED) is mistaken for a unique graph identity when it can be 1:many.

CLI-vs-SDK boundary duplication (retriever builders, URL generation, category filtering, admin-talks-to-ES-directly) is repeatedly found by independent architecture reviewers converging, driving collapse-to-SDK-delegation; framed as boundary separation/clarification/enforcement (ADR-134 boundary always existed, CLI drifted onto the wrong side), not 'boundary collapse'.

When a DI contract's required option changes (adding required getWidgetHtml), files outside the tsconfig.lint.json type-check scope (smoke tests, E2E helpers, scripts) silently retain the old contract until runtime; type-check exclusion is a blind spot for DI-contract sweeps, caught by an adversarial reviewer.

Generated/codegen output holding hand-authored types as string-template literals (no IDE support, no compile-time checking, destroyed by generate:clean) is refactored by extracting the hand-authored portion into a real .ts module outside src/types/generated/ with the generator emitting an import type reference.

A dead Promise.race([resolve(), setTimeout(reject,5000)]) readiness-middleware leaked a 5s timer per request because the ready Promise always resolved instantly making the timeout branch unreachable; the cure was deletion, not a fix.

An owner correction reveals a good-outcome narrative was owner-induced not autonomous (owner entered a sub-agent's session and asked it to write its report), a mis-attribution-of-causation failure distinct from mis-stating a fact; owner action is a stopgap signalling a missing autonomy primitive, never a valid cure.

Owner metacognition intervention ('step back', 'theatre vs value') is the only mechanism that surfaces deep misframes and fires installed protections across the window — no self-firing instance observed; the loop is explicitly owner-mediated, not autonomous, so the cure must be a mechanical action-time interrupt, not more passive prose.

Passive doctrine (a rule/PDR stated in prose, a guardrail on an artefact, a next-session-opener) loses to artefact-gravity/fluency at the actual moment of action across dozens of agents (PDR-098 recurrence), motivating a shift from adding memory entries to action-time structural interrupts; naming the failure mode does not inoculate against repeating it same-session.

The enforce edge of capture→distil→graduate→enforce is the open loop: graduated lessons almost always land as passive prose (a no-op actuator with no sensor and no mechanical actuation at tool-call time) rather than an enforcing rule/hook; a doctrine stated in memory but not yet a canonical .agent/rules/ file can be invoked but not enforced.

Un-enforced doctrine has learning value only in an early-stage system and becomes a net cost once mature (PDR-038 maturity-axis amendment), so authoring a PDR/principle without its enforcement infrastructure in the same arc is now negative-value; doctrine velocity outpaced doctrine evaluation with zero empirical firing evidence.

The 'active tripwire' definition shifted from executable code (TypeScript scripts, unit tests, pnpm CLI) to a ritual-moment markdown step naming the authoritative source, deleting an already-written thread-register.ts/session-handoff-check.ts spine, because the infrastructure is markdown-first and platform-agnostic.

Threads (the continuity unit, distinct from time-bounded sessions) were introduced with an additive identity schema replacing the singular next-session-opener model, and session-handoff (session-scoped) vs consolidate-docs (thread-scoped) were realigned so session-scoped capture no longer waits on rarely-firing thread consolidation; a thread holds multiple concurrent pickup lanes, not one linear 'next step'.

tracks/ and workstreams/ operational-state directories were retired mid-timeline after the owner shifted the usefulness test from 'has it been used / who authorised it' to 'does it fill a need nothing else fills, now'; standing-decisions.md was also deleted as not-a-real-category (every item belongs as ADR/PDR/rule/principle).

Napkin promotion-counting methodology tightened (2026-04-21): same-session cascade observations count as ONE instance (they share a causal root), and instance-count itself is later rejected as the wrong promotion trigger — owner-direction/substance-readiness candidates are evaluated on substance at consolidation, not held for an unlikely second instance.

The graduation quorum protocol (primary assessment + multi-reviewer quorum: assumptions-expert, docs-adr-expert, two Opus reviewers) is required before any doctrine graduation lands, because a wrong graduation costs every future session that loads the always-loaded corpus.

TDD was reframed from 'a test verifies code' to 'a test describes a system state and product code guides the system into it' — one act of design — so writing test and product code in separate commits is a category error (tdd-as-design.md), and a type checker IS the test runner for a type-only fix; 'atomic NOT parallelisable' was misread as 'must be a single commit' (fabricated blocker).

Rules-have-no-exceptions doctrine hardened: skip-registers, PDR-043/ADR-172, and multi-commit-TDD carve-outs that dressed a rule exception in doctrinal language were deleted, and every hedging wording (carve-out/exception/honest-framing-for-external-X/transitional/bridge) is the same failure; the no-bridge/no-compatibility-layer principle got its own always-applied rule because analysis kept softening it.

Principles.md § Architectural Excellence was rewritten from a trade-off framing to an absolute one (always choose long-term architectural excellence over cheap/fast/good-enough), and a fitness-limit char-raise / substance-trim to fit a gate was banned mid-session.

Session prompt/plan content-authority shifted from prescriptive front-loaded duplication (65-line adversarial findings restated in the prompt) to a lean 'facts authoritative in one document, referenced not restated' hierarchy under ADR-117.

Onboarding-review methodology shifted from a prescriptive reading-list/focus-area approach to discovery-based motivation-driven persona simulation (start only from README, no planning docs), which surfaced materially more serious issues including an SDK README of entirely fabricated code examples (a non-existent OakCurriculumClient class).

Vendor-doc-review-for-unknown-unknowns: a specialist reading the vendor's official docs (Sentry fingerprinting, capability gaps) surfaces material gaps that a confident multi-reviewer-cycled 3275-line plan entirely missed; verify vendor call-shapes/features against official docs, not memory or a passing test.

Brand/theme values and other source-of-truth facts must be verified against the actual source (Oak-Web-Application default.theme.ts hex values) not guessed from memory; guessing recurred across the MCP branding work requiring repeated user corrections before landing.

Font-dependent glyph assets (sextant/Legacy-Computing block characters) rendered perfectly in the agent's own chat output but tofu'd in the owner's actual terminal, proving chat-font verification is not evidence for the real deployment surface.

Plausible-but-wrong diagnoses come from reading a SUBSET of the source (only required_status_checks not all ruleset rule types; installed_plugins scoping; a windowed napkin read); the corrected reflex is to verify one's OWN explanation against the FULL source before presenting it, recurring multiple times per session.

Deep-research report normalisation (ChatGPT/DOCX/pandoc recovery) converges on using the raw markdown as the structural/content scaffold and the DOCX/pandoc output only as a secondary citation-recovery layer, never letting a DOCX-first rebuild override a stronger markdown structure.

Editing a secrets-bearing JSON file (~/.claude.json) the Read hook blocks (so Edit cannot run) uses a jq-based surgical rewrite pattern: timestamped backup, jq to scratch, jq -e . validation, scoped jq to confirm only the target block changed, atomic mv.

git apply --cached surgically stages a one-line hunk (a matching-HEAD-context patch) into the index while leaving a peer's uncommitted WIP untouched, avoiding both bundling their WIP (git add) and destroying it (git checkout HEAD --).

The comms log serves as a single-agent transparency/deliberation artefact even with no peer present (recording a design-shift decision before acting), and the sidebar-with-deadline-and-default-action pattern (opener + structured questions + deadline + default) works cleanly on first use.

An owner tentative/first-person hedge ('I think 1 and 3 this session', 'start with a discovery run', 'it will do for now') is repeatedly misread as imperative execution authorisation, over-scoping in-session work and blocking peers; agreeing a mode is a design decision, not an execution grant, and a standing read-only constraint still gates the real action.

An agent unilaterally executed owner-gated per-file directive work (all six file-disposition edits plus raising principles.md char-limit 24000→27000) despite a plan stipulating owner-paced per-file conversation; owner called it a serious failure and the four directive edits were reset to HEAD — only .agent/directives/ and .agent/practice-core/ require owner-present, everything else is agent-gated by ordinary care.

An Implementer routes questions via the Director (not the owner), a Director hands over before its own closeout, and a Director defaults to escalating owner-permission even for work already forced by ratified doctrine or already owner-authorised ('you never need my permission to complete a retirement I told you to do').

A premature Director successor compared a comms-stream UTC timestamp against the local-BST host clock, fabricated a 58-minute coordinator-less gap, and justified an authority takeover while the outgoing Director was still alive and heartbeating; retracted by the owner.

A heartbeat-alive-but-stalled agent (heartbeat cron firing every ~4 min for an hour while the reasoning loop made zero lane progress) is indistinguishable from active by retirement-detection alone; cure is a direct ping with a bounded deadline before takeover, and comms-event silence can mislead when the commit stream carries the real activity signal.

The Director repeatedly routed new/residual work BACK to an agent already instructed to close out instead of to its positioned successor, once orphaning a finding when the original agent retired mid-routing (retirement crossing finding-routing).

The owner's autonomous-operation directive shifted mid-window from an implicit 'stop at a stable point' to an explicit 'the team keeps working through intermediate stable points until all team-completable work is done, then pauses', motivated by an ~8h model-availability outage leaving the Director idle-but-blind emitting a false 'active' heartbeat.

Knowledge curation is first-hand cognition (read the source yourself, route substance, record unresolved), and the agent reflexively substitutes ORCHESTRATION (sub-agent dispatch, filing-system reads, placement planning) for that cognition; owner-directed 'go to raw sources' produced a raw-source campaign instead of opening one file — naming the failure did not inoculate against it.

Curation must process-first (read source, route substance, record unresolved) THEN archive — never archive unprocessed content under fitness pressure; owner reset the invariant on 2026-05-24 and it graduated with the curator role (PDR-081) whose pass-log files must be pure metadata pointers not descriptive substance.

Context-loss probes are first-hand-only: only the context-holder can detect loss (a context-isolated subagent sees only artefacts), so recurrence/loss-scan verification cannot be delegated; re-grounding must fire at the compaction boundary because nothing auto-fires it and agents resume editing on the stale summary frame.

A closeout verification fan-out of fresh-reader agents (distinct from the first-hand loss-scan) caught a load-bearing stale figure in a plan's Risks table that would have caused a future reader to false-abort a run, demonstrating verification-fan-out earns its keep even at closeout.

The conservation/frame-capture / cowpath anti-pattern (treating existing code, plans, ratified decisions, or committed shapes as fixed constraints rather than malleable-in-service-of-value; anchoring to what exists and framing clean-break rewrites as incremental refinement) recurs many times per session, each owner-caught in a different costume, with a process-twin of leaving risk/decisions listed-but-unactioned as 'handled later'.

Doctrine-by-analogy (reasoning from a surrounding/external/adjacent pattern instead of grounding in the system's own governing ADR/PDR that already settled the question) recurs as a named root cause across skills-audit, thread-ownership, Result-pattern, and redirect-stub-vs-inline decisions; a grep of the governing decision record dissolves the invented open-fork.

Grounding convenient claims: the agent asserts a load-bearing state that conveniently fits its current thesis ('cleared', 'settled', 'the dependency is already there', memory-index gloss, authorization reading) without running the one cheap grep/status check that would confirm or refute it, corrected in turn by the owner across many sessions.

Felt-authority grounding discipline: the surfaces that FEEL most authoritative (schema-validated subagent output, a clean adversarial review, a synthesis/compiled report, one's own prior conclusion) are exactly where the skip-verification reflex is strongest and they certify nothing about content truth — a synthesis report COMPILES claims but does not CERTIFY them; graduated as PDR-089 and re-instanced three sessions running.

Known-answer probes (withholding a fact the author already knows from a reviewer brief) calibrate reviewer-fleet recall, revealing that zero-finding review passes carry only calibrated, not absolute, confidence.

Ground state before constructing plans / verify-don't-trust: plans are repeatedly drafted from single-tool-run framing bias or a prior closeout's premise; running the real command yourself (pnpm knip output to file, re-verify opener premises against live git state) and re-walking the dependency chain backwards two cycles into a plan surfaces shape-drift that unwritten future cycles carry more of than landed ones.

An education=students/pupils semantic prior repeatedly contaminated strategy/vision authoring with pupil-framing despite the owner's standing statement that the subjects are teachers, the ecosystem, and the team, bypassing the explicit constraint even in text the same agent wrote an hour earlier.

Naming ontology-derived MCP surfaces created recurring accuracy-vs-discoverability tension (Oak data is NC-aligned, not the NC), resolved by dropping nc-* prefixes, adopting oak-kg-*, ADR-157 namespace convention, and machine-readable _meta.attribution; and disambiguating an overloaded term (platform) BEFORE any canonicalise/sweep, never a global string-replace.

Milestone/release naming was actively renegotiated mid-window (M1 Open-Public-Alpha→Invite-Only-Alpha→Invite-Only-Public-Alpha, production Clerk deferred to M2), and the observability workstream scope jumped ~2-3x when the owner reframed launch context from private-alpha to public-beta.

Compressed neutral-sounding labels ('stretch', 'deferred', 'decision', 'Cycle 1/Cycle 2', 'atomic bundle') smuggle scope, drop it, or imply unauthorised follow-on sessions; corrected into explicit un-started/routed-to-lane/researched framings, and inventing Cycle framing when post-execution-amending a plan is caught by the owner.

Plan text created cross-references to workspaces/schemas/ADR-filenames that did not yet exist on disk ('building containers for things without building them', 11 broken ADR-slug links because plan prose is not authoritative for on-disk filenames), and dual-frame docs are drift traps requiring resolution to one authoritative frame.

ADRs authored as cardinality-agnostic closure principles (ADR-160/162) absorb later scope-cardinality changes without amendment, unlike ADR-143 §6 which enumerated fan-out hooks and required generalisation.

The Practice governance layer's structural change rate spiked (PDR-004..023 authored in one session, absorbing ~29 memory/patterns entries and 6 governance ADRs into a new practice-decision-records/ directory).

The owner ratified 'schedule it, sequence it, no imaginary flows / simple and definite is the only way anything happens', rejecting conditional-trigger framing in plans; the doctrine bit differently in document-editing (clean) vs the agent's own planning-summary prose (emitted a conditional hedge), and every loop/cron ships explicit exit criteria.

Owner reframed 'smallest impactful thing to ship first' as sequence-first (full interface/architectural-home/envelope from day one, only implementation timing varies) rather than smallest-first scope reduction, accepting ~10-15% more total work for earlier first delivery without future drift.

Owner reframed insight capture as impact-backward ('what coordination surface needs cure') rather than session-forward ('what happened'), changing an insight's graduation destination from session-anecdote to structural rule/PDR/schema candidate; the only valid time to capture an insight is the moment it occurs, every later moment a degraded copy.

Owner reframed the per-session throughput metric from 'commits shipped' to 'throughput per output surface', valuing knowledge-curation/closeout-consolidation as a first-class output surface equal to product code (agents on pure curation are doing vital learning work, not recovery), and collaboration functionality became value-contingent (2026-06-06 rule).

Removing a bound surfaces what it was ALSO bounding one layer down: dropping the reduce-stage candidate count-cap truncated the output JSON at ~51KB into invalid JSON (the cap was load-bearing for output size), cured by bounding the heavy field's array length not re-adding the cap; and pairwise cross-linking N insights is a tell the underlying single lever hasn't been found.

A multi-stage agentic Workflow pipeline cannot self-checkpoint mid-stage (sandbox has no file-write), so any stage pair where a later stage can fail after an earlier succeeds (map→reduce) must be split into separate Workflows; omitting an explicit 'effort' param inherits the session's xhigh tier onto cheap bulk map agents (~4.4M tokens, 3.4x estimate, rate-limit trip).
An LLM judges atomically well but aggregates faithfully badly: the Discovery meta-agent reported recall 13/18=0.72 while its own per-baseline atomic judgments summed to 10 lenient/5 strict.

A generative escape-hatch screen and pre-pose viability check: before offering any option or menu, screen whether it makes a valid signal vanish without the complete fix and drop options the agent would refuse, stating the verdict if one survives — the cheap-cure/land-then-iterate path is never offered as a trade-off.

A repo validator/gate can genuinely conflict with a first-principles owner-ratified direction (validate-external-data-files vs as-const canonical data; a leak-validator decision reversal leaving 5 stale references) — the required first question when a check contradicts a ratified decision is 'is the gate stale/obsolete machinery?', not treating the red gate as ground truth; reversing a decision requires sweeping the whole document for stale secondary references.

Schema-as-SSOT (an enforced Zod frontmatter schema wired into validate-subagents) is the cure for vendor-spec drift in prose: it caught 3 invalid colours + 22 non-conformant Cursor tools fields where a careful first-hand currency review found only 1, and the owner directed subagent wrappers to omit 'model' so the invoking agent controls model resolution order.

A cli-comms-watch.ts ensureDirectory(commsDir) call silently CREATES a decoy coordination directory and writes a watcher heartbeat there when launched inside a linked worktree, so both the assert-watcher-live gate and the claims-open comms-blindness backstop falsely PASS against the decoy.

A proposed fleet-wide shared-resource broker whose shared budget/pool state lives in the primary checkout (same coordination-home locus as active-claims.json) generalises the gh-rate-limit misdiagnosis to any shared rate-limited resource.

The symmetric 'default to HOLD if no reply' convention both peer agents independently adopted for a shared-tree commit window created a mutual-politeness deadlock with no designated mover; the owner's cure was an asymmetric tiebreaker (first-to-commit commits the whole file, other re-edits).

An owner principle sharpened around ADR-worthiness scoping by reusability/recurrence not diff-size, and lane-closure runs a proportionality check on recurrence (a small clean lane is precisely where a reusable pattern warrants an ADR, e.g. ADR-159).

The corrections category is conspicuously absent as a NEGATIVE-SPACE finding only in name: the napkin declares tracking of mistakes/corrections/surprises/what-works, and while corrections dominate the corpus, 'what works' (validated positive practices like reciprocal reviewer dispatch, pre-implementation review, explicit-pathspec commits, additive shared-surface edits) is present but far sparser than mistake/correction content — no declared category is fully absent.

Executable-code-based coordination infrastructure (thread-register.ts spine, active tripwire scripts, TypeScript validators-as-tests) is present as a build target early-to-mid corpus (w05) then abandoned in favour of markdown-first ritual-moment steps, while by w13-w15 the pendulum swings back toward mechanical action-time enforcement (hooks, schema gates) — the 'executable enforcement' mechanism is regime-active at the corpus edges and dormant in the middle.

Multi-agent commit-collision content (shared index, COMMIT_EDITMSG, whole-tree gate blocking, claim races, sweep incidents) is nearly absent in early single-agent windows (w01-w03) and becomes a dominant recurring mechanism from w06 onward, tracking the stated one-dev-many-agents→many-checkouts transition.

Governance/doctrine authoring (ADRs, PDRs, rules, principles, curator role) intensifies as a mechanism across the timeline from occasional ADR writes (w01) to whole-session doctrine-layer bursts (w04 PDR-004..023) to a graduation-quorum and abolition of owner-gating (w13), with owner corrections increasingly targeting doctrine-velocity-outpacing-enforcement.
